title: Independent experts to review handling of Jalen Hurts’ blood clot situation as NFL gives insight into process

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Independent experts to review handling of Jalen Hurts’ blood clot situation as NFL gives insight into process
sources.description: In response to an October letter from Delaware Sen. Lisa Blunt Rochester, the NFL provided additional information about the review and its procedures for tracking blood clots.
